<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 20:33">Targ. I Kings XX, 33</cite> <he>וחטפוהא מיניה</he> they snatched the word hastily from him (h. text <he>ויחלטו הממנו</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 33b:8">B. Bath. 33ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>דמִיחֲטַף חַטְפָהּ מיניה</he> that he took it from him forcibly.
<cite ref="Chullin 133a:6">Ḥull. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>היה חֲטִיפְנָא מתנתא</he> I used to take the priest’s gifts eagerly (v. <cite ref="H00013"><he>חֲבַב</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:4">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>חֲטוֹף ואכול וכ׳</he> make haste and eat &c. (enjoy life, while you live).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 22:26">Targ. Ez. XXII, 26</cite>.

senses.gloss: (of animals of prey) to tear. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 דובין חטפין (read: דֵּיבִין) the wolves (on Solomon’s throne) made an attempt to tear (the false witness). Ib. למחטיף לבהון וכ׳, as if to tear the hearts &c.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 13:2">Targ. Prov. XIII, 2</cite>.—Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵇ top <he>והיא מִתְחַטְּפָא</he> and it is taken by force (confiscated).
